Name: NoodleJubblies' Pink Hair for SO-SCA Haley
Author: NoodleJubblies
Description:
I always thought Haley would look absolutely adorable with pink hair. Once I started playing Stardew on PC, and delving into mods, I found the incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] and fell in love. The only thing missing? Haley with pink hair! [b]DUN DUN DUUUUuuunnnnn...[/b]
So I set to work. Along the way, I also brought her open mouth smile back, because it is super adorable and was missing in the original mod. 
What does this mod do? Gives Haley pink hair in ALL of her outfits, including at the beach and festivals. Newest version also updates her 8-heart event photos! This obviously requires SO-SCA. It was designed for it. So you need it. Get it. It's amazing. Then download this sucker and enjoy!

[b][i][u]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS[/u][/i][/b]

This is a drag and drop addon mod to SO-SCA. I didn't want to mess up anything in Poltergeister's original mod syntax, so avoided it in general. Here's how to install the addon:
1. Backup the your Stardew Valley folder. Just copy and paste that whole folder somewhere in case you decide you don't like Haley with cute pink hair (YOU MONSTER!).
2. Extract the zip file and copy the 'assets' and 'content' folders.
3. Paste it inside 'common>Stardew Valley.' It will ask if you want to replace 18 files. ACCEPT!
4. Enjoy your somehow even cuter Haley! \(^.^)/

[b][u]THANK YOU's[/u][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for the amazing mod in the first place. It inspired me to undertake this whole project! I was so happy to get your permission to do this! 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41168370]HopeWasHere[/url] for giving me permission to alter the Haley sprites and portraits they made for Poltergeister's mod. Her hair is AMAZING with how it changes in seasons, and making it pink was just EPIC.
